name: fred_yield_spread
description:
The 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield spread (negative values are a common recession signal) from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series T10Y2Y (percentage points, daily).
Returns {"series": "T10Y2Y", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id (string; default T10Y2Y, this tool's series), limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 20).
Related: fred_2yr_treasury, fred_10yr_treasury.
Example: {"series_id": "T10Y2Y", "limit": 20}

series_id.description: FRED series id; defaults to this tool's series

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
